summary: FINAL pre-deployment operational readiness gate for MASCI Operations Platform PASSED. All 376 Incident Engine lock tests pass (11 test files, 1.61s). PDF pipeline smoke (6 new tests) confirms MASCI wordmark, Attorney Work Product footer, class='story' Case Story paragraph, class='tline' narrative timeline, empty-photograph-section suppression, valid %PDF- header, and PDF ≥10KB. Frontend spot check on preview URL: /incidents/report renders exactly 17 unique incident-type cards (vehicle_accident … other), EN/ES header toggle works both ways (Spanish content confirmed after ES click), Vehicle Accident card opens multi-step branch flow with progress rail (STEP 1/8, 0%). All 6 field workflow routes (/incidents/report, /daily/submit, /equipment/submit, /fleet/dvir/new, /meetings/submit, /near-miss) return HTTP 200 with no React error overlay and 0 console errors. Preview banner ('PREVIEW ENVIRONMENT · DB: MASCI_SAFETY_PREVIEW') present. Mobile 375x667 (iPhone SE proxy) after fresh state: no horizontal overflow (sw=cw=375), sticky header (position:sticky, top:0), ES button 44x44 within viewport (thumb-reachable), 2 cards fully visible + 3rd partially visible in initial fold. Email routing architecture audit: email_routing.py exposes 6 legacy DB-backed overrides with env fallbacks (always_cc, safety_forms_to, leadership_always_to, shop_manager_fallback, severe_incident_cc, backup_email_to). email_routing_v2.py is canonical DB-first resolver — falls back to legacy_provider when EMAIL_ROUTING_V2=false (line 201), reads db.email_routes when true (line 162), audit collection email_routing_audit_v2 is append-only (write_audit line 318, comment line 64). Zero-drift confirmed: server.py imports register_incident_lifecycle_routes (line 2538), has explicit 'Legacy /api/incidents/* surface is UNTOUCHED (Zero-Drift Doctrine)' comment (line 2552), and all incident-engine routers register alongside legacy. No P0/P1 issues found — Track 19.18 is ready for production deployment.

issues: Only 2 incident cards fully visible in initial fold + 1 partial (review request asked for at least 3 fully). Non-blocking — foreman can still see multiple options at a glance and scrolls easily. Consider tightening card top-padding by ~4-6pt to fit a 3rd fully in the fold. P2.

action_items: P2 (optional cosmetic): Tighten /incidents/report initial-fold vertical density on 375-wide viewports so a 3rd incident card is fully in-view before scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: email_routing_v2.py resolver correctly enforces flag-gated behavior — EMAIL_ROUTING_V2=false returns legacy exactly with no DB read/no audit (line 201-202), preventing audit pressure during rollout. Good.
Audit collection email_routing_audit_v2 is append-only by contract (no update/delete paths in module) — write_audit is best-effort with try/except so never blocks the calling flow. Good.

server.py line 2552 explicitly declares the Zero-Drift Doctrine for /api/incidents legacy surface — good self-documenting boundary. All incident_engine.* routers are registered without shadowing legacy routes.
IncidentReport.jsx at 1674 lines — pre-existing (flagged in iter_track_19_18), still above the 700-line guideline. Not a Track 19.18 regression. Suggest splitting after deployment.
i18n.js duplicate-key baseline (692 occurrences) is pre-existing tech debt. Not a Track 19.18 regression.
